assertions.assertion: Step 0 extracts the Embargo policy URL from the Security Configuration as an optional field without raising an error (§1.71 — backward compatible extraction)
assertions.evidence: data-extraction.md line 14 shows 'Embargo policy URL | https://example.com/security/embargo-policy' and lines 16-17 state 'The Embargo policy URL was extracted as an optional field from Security Configuration without raising an error. It is present and will be used in Step 1.7.'

assertions.assertion: Step 1.7 evaluates the CVE severity — CVSS 7.5 (High) meets the Critical/Important threshold (CVSS >= 7.0) and triggers the embargo warning gate (§1.70)
assertions.evidence: embargo-check.md lines 12-20 show a severity evaluation table with 'CVSS Score | 7.5', 'Severity Level | High', 'Threshold | CVSS >= 7.0 (Critical/Important)', 'Threshold Met? | YES -- 7.5 >= 7.0' and the statement 'This triggers the embargo warning gate.'

assertions.assertion: Step 1.7 presents a warning gate to the engineer including the CVE ID (CVE-2026-31812), severity level, a statement about embargo risk, and a link to the configured embargo policy URL (https://example.com/security/embargo-policy) (§1.70)
assertions.evidence: embargo-check.md lines 33-41 show the warning gate with 'EMBARGO CHECK -- CVE-2026-31812 (High severity, CVSS 7.5)', 'High-severity vulnerabilities may be under embargo. Before proceeding, verify with your security team that this CVE is cleared for public triage.', and 'Embargo policy: https://example.com/security/embargo-policy'.

assertions.assertion: Step 1.7 requires explicit engineer confirmation (Yes/No) before proceeding to Step 2 — the gate is a confirmation prompt, not an informational message (§1.70)
assertions.evidence: embargo-check.md lines 29-31 state 'Triage does not proceed to Step 2 until the engineer provides an explicit Yes/No confirmation.' Line 41 shows 'Proceed with triage? (Yes / No)'. Lines 65-67 explicitly state 'The gate is a confirmation prompt, not an informational message. The engineer must explicitly choose Yes or No before the skill proceeds.'

assertions.assertion: The embargo warning gate does NOT trigger for Low or Moderate severity CVEs (CVSS < 7.0) — it is skipped silently when severity is below threshold (§1.70)
assertions.evidence: embargo-check.md lines 22-24 state 'Note: If the severity were Low or Moderate (CVSS < 7.0), this step would be skipped silently and triage would proceed directly to Step 2 without presenting any warning.' Line 69 reiterates 'The embargo warning gate does NOT trigger for Low or Moderate severity CVEs (CVSS < 7.0). It is skipped silently when severity is below threshold.'
